source: Program/Layer/Keygroup/AnalogADSR come from the native-validated analog-v1 builder template. The WaveTableOscillator element is assembled from the indexed parameter list (data/parameters.json); on Windows Falcon 27.0.2 (owned VST3 host, 2026-11-01) its attribute set matched Falcon-saved elements, survived a load/readback with number formatting changes only, and rendered in tune on notes 45/57/69/81 with an absolute WavetablePath and the marker clm chunk.
upgrade: Pass template_from=<Falcon-saved .uvip/.uvim> to copy another saved element (all persisted attributes and children); only WavetablePath and the listed parameters are rewritten.
